decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the first floor extension is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west walls of the first floor hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The first floor hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for the purposes ancillary to the residential use of the single-family dwelling known as 31 Kings Avenue
description: ERECTION OF FIRST FLOOR TO BUNGALOW TO CREATE TWO-STOREY DETACHED DWELLINGHOUSE
